images.content: end of a DIFFERENT Van Beuningen dispatch of 19/29 Sept 1657 (on Brandenburg/Poland/Sweden), and start of another letter -- NOT the target letter; kept for context so a later worker does not re-identify it as the target
continuation and close of the Brandenburg/Poland letter above, also dated Coppenhaghen 19/29 September 1657 -- a second, separate same-day dispatch, not the target

PLAIN COPY, leaf 1: docket at top reads (abbreviated) '...de 19en Octob. 1657' matching the printed edition's footnote quote of De Witt's endorsement 'beantwoort den 19en October 1657'; body opens 'Mijn Heer, Hier wert van dag tot dag met groot impatientie verlangt na [...] Rosewinge...' -- matches Brieven aan Johan de Witt I p.405 word for word from its first line

PLAIN COPY, leaf 2 (continuation, signature, date): ends 'UEd: ootmoedigen en verplichten dienaer, [signed] Van Beuningen' and 'Coppenhagen de 19/29 [Septem]bris 1657' -- confirms the double Julian/Gregorian date the printed edition cites as '(19/29 September 1657)'

CIPHER COPY, leaf 1 ('van een andere hand' per the footnote -- visibly a different, more cramped hand than 0208/0209): opens 'Hier voort van dag tot dag met groot impatientie verlangt na U [cipher numbers]...' -- same opening as the plain copy, with the content words replaced by comma-separated 2-digit numeric groups and colons apparently marking word boundaries; plain Dutch function words (mijn, heer, met, over, onder, daer, etc.) are left uncoded

CIPHER COPY, leaf 2 (continuation, signature, date): ends '... Godt Blijve, Mijn Heer, UEd: ootmoedigen [en] verplichten dienaer, [signed] Van Beuningen' and 'Coppenhaghen den 19/29 [Septem]bris 1657' -- same closing formula and identical double date as the plain copy, confirming this is the cipher copy of the SAME letter, not of the other 19/29 Sept dispatch on ff.206-207
